name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Either Electrical goes with Ford or Aerospace goes with Edison.
Diesel goes with Software if and only if Tesla goes with Aerospace.
Between Edison and Tesla, one goes with Drill and the other with Laser.
Either Edison goes with Laser or Diesel goes with Electrical.
Diesel, Edison, and Ford go with Electrical, Software, and Wrench, in some order.

hints.text: Suppose Edison went with Electrical — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Edison goes with Electrical.
Edison goes with Electrical, so it can't also go with Aerospace.
Electrical goes with Edison, so Ford can't go with Electrical.
…but now the clue “Either Electrical goes with Ford or Aerospace goes with Edison” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Edison does not go with Electrical.
